Conversely every partition of the c components gives an admissible S5 relation. Prefix unions X_j=C1 union...union C_j are upward closed; the differences L_R(X_j)\L_R(X_{j-1}) isolate the unique class whose highest component index is j, and the final complement determines the last block. For any q<c-1 arbitrary upsets X_j, append all-ones to their component-not-contained incidence matrix; a nonzero kernel vector has positive and negative nonempty sign supports B,D with the same all-or-none containment across all tests. Partitions separating versus merging B,D are indistinguishable. Boundary c=1 needs zero tests. Checked non-discrete component arguments and discrete n-world specialization.
